spec_case: runtime-semantics.md Section 1.1 (YAML block scalars) / Section 8.6 (use, inline)
description: An inline `use` child's rendered text is always stripped of its own trailing line break (core/use.py::_clean_yaml_fences), so a child document whose last value is a block scalar is the common, real-world case issue #493's end-of-input divergence actually hits. Both engines now load that trailing block scalar the same way PyYAML does.
